text: Pentland Group describes itself as 'a family business building and delivering positive brands in sports, outdoor and fashion'; its Pentland Brands arm owns Canterbury ('It owns Speedo, Berghaus, Canterbury, Endura, ellesse, SeaVees, Red Or Dead and Mitre').
short: Canterbury is owned by Pentland Brands, part of family-owned Pentland Group.

source.note: Undated page; the date given is the day it was checked. The same page describes Pentland Group as 'a family business building and delivering positive brands in sports, outdoor and fashion' and says Pentland Group holds a 51.89% share in JD Sports Fashion plc.
